description: Données territoriales pour le diagnostic des schémas directeurs IRVE is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Fédération Nationale des Collectivités Concédantes et Régies. Community-wide statistical data (INSEE sources) to estimate the need for charging points open to the public in the context of the development of an IRVE master plan for a territory, CODE: INSEE code of the municipality or borough (COG), TYPE: Commune (COM) or Municipal Arrondissement (ARM), NAME: Name of the municipality or ... Coverage: Fédération Nationale des Collectivités Concédantes et Régies. The portal shows the English title as "Territorial data for the diagnosis of IRVE master plans" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Fédération Nationale des Collectivités Concédantes et Régies. Its keywords include irve, sdirve. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2023-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
